disableBuiltInSignIn.title: Turn off sign-in through the Databricks CLI's public client
disableBuiltInSignIn.description: When true, Lakeline never signs in through the public OAuth client that Databricks provides for its own CLI (databricks-cli). Users sign in with a personal access token or with the app connection set in oauthClientId.

oauthClientId.title: Your organization's Lakeline app connection
oauthClientId.description: OAuth client ID of a public app connection registered in the Databricks account console (redirect https://<extension-id>.chromiumapp.org/, scopes sql and all-apis). When set, Lakeline signs in through it instead of the Databricks CLI's public client.
